title: palicourea subtomentosa
intro: Palicourea subtomentosa, commonly known as "Santo Daime" or "Marinella", is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae, native to the Amazon rainforest. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in reducing pain and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
